contract.task_clause:
Which one of the following is the most appropriate definition of a 99% confidence interval?
Option A: 99% of the time in repeated samples, the interval would contain the true value of the parameter
Option B: 99% of the time in repeated samples, the interval would contain the estimated value of the parameter
Option C: 99% of the time in repeated samples, the null hypothesis will be rejected
Option D: 99% of the time in repeated samples, the null hypothesis will not be rejected when it was false
